item.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Execute a GraphQL Query or Mutation

request.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Execute a GraphQL Query or Mutation

description.content: Executes a GraphQL query or mutation against the Salesforce UIAPI schema. The UIAPI schema provides access to records, object metadata, list views, and related data. Supports standard GraphQL features including variables, fragments, and operation names. Queries are scoped to the UIAPI namespace which provides formatted field values, layout-aware data access, and respects sharing rules.
